data.name: Invisibility
data.description: As a standard action, you can become invisible (as per the invisibility spell). You can remain invisible for %1 minute per day. This duration does not need to be consecutive, but it must be spent in 1-minute increments. Starting at 9th level, each time you activate this ability you can treat it as greater invisibility, though each round spent this way counts as 1 minute of your normal invisibility duration.|OracleInvisibilityDuration
